# Observable Framework

> Observable Framework is a free, open-source static site generator for data apps, dashboards, reports, and more. Write Markdown with reactive JavaScript, SQL, Python, R, and any language you like. Framework compiles it into a static site with instant page loads.

Observable Framework combines JavaScript on the front-end for interactive graphics with any language on the back-end for data analysis via data loaders.

## Core Concepts

- **Markdown Pages**: Write pages in Markdown with embedded JavaScript code blocks
- **Data Loaders**: Generate static data snapshots at build time using any language
- **Reactive JavaScript**: Code re-runs automatically when referenced variables change
- **Static Site Generation**: Compiles to fast, deployable static HTML/JS/CSS

## Getting Started

Create a new app:
```bash
npx "@observablehq/framework@latest" create
```

Start the development server:
```bash
npm run dev
```

Build for production:
```bash
npm run build
```

## Project Structure

```
.
├─ src/                    # source root
│  ├─ .observablehq/
│  │  └─ cache/            # data loader cache
│  ├─ components/
│  │  └─ chart.js          # shared JavaScript module
│  ├─ data/
│  │  └─ quakes.csv.ts     # data loader
│  ├─ index.md             # home page
│  └─ dashboard.md         # additional page
├─ observablehq.config.js  # app configuration
└─ package.json
```

## Markdown

Framework Markdown extends CommonMark with:
- **JavaScript code blocks** (`\`\`\`js`) - reactive code that runs in the browser
- **Inline expressions** (`${...}`) - interpolate values into prose
- **YAML front matter** - page configuration
- **HTML blocks** - for layouts and custom elements
- **Grids and cards** - dashboard layout helpers

### Front Matter Options
```yaml
---
title: My Page
toc: false        # disable table of contents
theme: dashboard  # use dashboard theme
sidebar: false    # hide sidebar
sql:
  data: ./data.parquet  # register SQL tables
---
```

### JavaScript Code Blocks

Expression blocks display their result:
```js
1 + 2  // displays: 3
```

Program blocks define variables:
```js
const data = await FileAttachment("data.csv").csv({typed: true});
```

Show code with `echo` directive:
```js echo
Plot.barX(data, {y: "name", x: "value"}).plot()
```

### Inline Expressions

Interpolate values: `The count is ${count}.`

### Grids and Cards

```html
<div class="grid grid-cols-2">
  <div class="card">Content A</div>
  <div class="card">Content B</div>
</div>
```

Grid classes: `grid-cols-1`, `grid-cols-2`, `grid-cols-3`, `grid-cols-4`
Span classes: `grid-colspan-2`, `grid-rowspan-2`

### Notes/Callouts

```html
<div class="note">This is a note.</div>
<div class="tip">This is a tip.</div>
<div class="warning">This is a warning.</div>
<div class="caution">This is a caution.</div>
```

## JavaScript

### display(value)
Display content on the page. Returns the value.
```js
display(Plot.barX(data).plot());
display({hello: "world"});  // inspector view
```

### resize(render)
Responsive rendering - re-renders when container size changes:
```js
resize((width, height) => Plot.barX(data).plot({width, height}))
```

### Built-in Variables
- `width` - current width of main element (reactive)
- `now` - current time in milliseconds (reactive, updates continuously)

### Implicit Display
Expression code blocks automatically display their result:
```js
Plot.barX(data).plot()  // automatically displayed
```

## Reactivity

Code blocks run like a spreadsheet - automatically re-running when referenced variables change.

### Top-Level Variables
Variables declared in one code block can be referenced in others:
```js
const x = 1;
```
```js
x + 1  // displays: 2
```

### Promises
Promises are implicitly awaited across code blocks:
```js
const data = FileAttachment("data.csv").csv();
```
```js
data  // already resolved, not a promise
```

### Generators
Generators yield values over time, triggering re-renders:
```js
const pointer = Generators.observe((notify) => {
  const handler = (e) => notify([e.clientX, e.clientY]);
  addEventListener("pointermove", handler);
  return () => removeEventListener("pointermove", handler);
});
```

### Inputs
Use `view` to create reactive inputs:
```js
const selection = view(Inputs.select(["A", "B", "C"], {label: "Choose:"}));
```
```js
selection  // re-runs when selection changes
```

### Mutables
For state that can be modified from multiple places:
```js
import {Mutable} from "observablehq:stdlib";
const count = Mutable(0);
const increment = () => ++count.value;
```

### invalidation
Promise that resolves when code block is invalidated (for cleanup):
```js
const interval = setInterval(() => console.log("tick"), 1000);
invalidation.then(() => clearInterval(interval));
```

## Files (FileAttachment)

Load files from your source directory:
```js
import {FileAttachment} from "observablehq:stdlib";

// Various formats
const json = await FileAttachment("data.json").json();
const csv = await FileAttachment("data.csv").csv({typed: true});
const tsv = await FileAttachment("data.tsv").tsv({typed: true});
const text = await FileAttachment("readme.txt").text();
const parquet = await FileAttachment("data.parquet").arrow();
const image = await FileAttachment("photo.jpg").image();
const xlsx = await FileAttachment("data.xlsx").xlsx();
const sqlite = await FileAttachment("database.sqlite").sqlite();
const zip = await FileAttachment("archive.zip").zip();
```

File properties:
- `file.name` - filename
- `file.mimeType` - MIME type
- `file.lastModified` - modification timestamp
- `file.size` - size in bytes
- `file.href` - resolved URL

**Important**: FileAttachment paths must be static string literals for static analysis.

## Data Loaders

Data loaders run at build time to generate static data snapshots.

### File-Based Routing
The loader `quakes.csv.js` generates `quakes.csv`:
```js
// src/data/quakes.csv.js
const response = await fetch("https://earthquake.usgs.gov/...");
const data = await response.json();
process.stdout.write(csvFormat(data.features));
```

### Supported Languages
- `.js` - JavaScript (node)
- `.ts` - TypeScript (tsx)
- `.py` - Python (python3)
- `.R` - R (Rscript)
- `.sh` - Shell script (sh)
- `.exe` - Executable

### Archives
Data loaders can generate ZIP/tar archives; extract files with FileAttachment:
```js
FileAttachment("data/file.csv")  // from data.zip
```

### Caching
- Cache stored in `.observablehq/cache`
- Loader re-runs if source file is newer than cached output
- Clear cache: `rm -rf src/.observablehq/cache`

## SQL

SQL code blocks query data with DuckDB:

### Register Tables (front matter)
```yaml
---
sql:
  flights: ./data/flights.parquet
  weather: https://example.com/weather.csv
---
```

### SQL Code Blocks
```sql
SELECT * FROM flights WHERE delay > 60 LIMIT 10
```

### Named Results
```sql id=delayed
SELECT origin, count(*) as n FROM flights WHERE delay > 60 GROUP BY 1
```
Then reference `delayed` in JavaScript.

### Destructuring
```sql id=[top]
SELECT * FROM flights ORDER BY delay DESC LIMIT 1
```

### Interpolation
```sql
SELECT * FROM flights WHERE origin = ${selectedAirport}
```

### SQL Tagged Template
```js
const result = await sql`SELECT count(*) FROM flights`;
```

## Imports

### npm Imports
```js
import confetti from "npm:canvas-confetti";
import * as d3 from "npm:d3";
import {rollup} from "npm:d3-array";
```

### Local Imports
```js
import {MyChart} from "./components/chart.js";
```

### Node Imports
After `npm install`:
```js
import _ from "lodash";
```

### Implicit Imports (available by default)
- `FileAttachment`, `Generators`, `Mutable`, `resize` from stdlib
- `Plot` - Observable Plot
- `d3` - D3.js
- `Inputs` - Observable Inputs
- `html`, `svg` - Hypertext Literal
- `DuckDBClient`, `sql` - DuckDB
- `Arrow`, `aq` - Apache Arrow, Arquero
- `L` - Leaflet
- `tex` - KaTeX
- `mermaid`, `dot` - Diagrams
- And more...

## Configuration (observablehq.config.js)

```js
export default {
  title: "My App",
  root: "src",           // source directory
  output: "dist",        // build output
  theme: "dashboard",    // or ["light", "dark"]

  pages: [
    {name: "Overview", path: "/overview"},
    {
      name: "Analysis",
      pages: [
        {name: "Sales", path: "/analysis/sales"},
        {name: "Users", path: "/analysis/users"}
      ]
    }
  ],

  head: '<link rel="icon" href="favicon.png">',
  header: "My Company",
  footer: "Built with Observable Framework",

  sidebar: true,
  pager: true,
  toc: {show: true, label: "Contents"},
  search: true
};
```

### Theme Options
Light themes: `air`, `cotton`, `glacier`, `parchment`
Dark themes: `coffee`, `deep-space`, `ink`, `midnight`, `near-midnight`, `ocean-floor`, `slate`, `stark`, `sun-faded`
Modifiers: `alt` (swap backgrounds), `wide` (full-width)
Aliases: `default`, `dashboard`, `light`, `dark`

## Deploying

### GitHub Pages
Create `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`:
```yaml
name: Deploy
on:
  push: {branches: [main]}
  schedule: [{cron: "15 10 * * *"}]
  workflow_dispatch: {}

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pages: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: {node-version: 22, cache: npm}
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - uses: actions/configure-pages@v4
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with: {path: dist}
      - uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
```

### Static Hosting
The `dist` folder can be deployed to any static hosting:
- GitHub Pages
- Netlify
- Vercel
- Cloudflare Pages
- Self-hosted

## Observable Plot

Built-in charting library:
```js
Plot.plot({
  marks: [
    Plot.barY(data, {x: "category", y: "value"}),
    Plot.ruleY([0])
  ]
})
```

Common marks: `dot`, `line`, `area`, `bar`, `rect`, `cell`, `text`, `rule`, `tick`, `link`, `arrow`, `image`, `geo`, `raster`, `contour`

Options: `x`, `y`, `fill`, `stroke`, `r`, `opacity`, `tip` (tooltips)

## Observable Inputs

```js
// Select
view(Inputs.select(["A", "B", "C"], {label: "Choice"}))

// Radio
view(Inputs.radio(["A", "B", "C"], {label: "Choice"}))

// Checkbox
view(Inputs.checkbox(["A", "B", "C"], {label: "Options"}))

// Range/Slider
view(Inputs.range([0, 100], {label: "Value", step: 1}))

// Text
view(Inputs.text({label: "Name", placeholder: "Enter name"}))

// Search (with datalist)
view(Inputs.search(data, {label: "Search"}))

// Table
view(Inputs.table(data, {columns: ["name", "value"]}))

// Button
view(Inputs.button("Click me", {reduce: () => count++}))
```

## DuckDB

```js
// Create client
const db = await DuckDBClient.of({
  flights: FileAttachment("flights.parquet")
});

// Query
const result = await db.query("SELECT * FROM flights LIMIT 10");

// SQL tagged template
const delayed = await db.sql`SELECT * FROM flights WHERE delay > 60`;
```
